context_diary: The platform's database contains substantial account volume that exceeds my processing limits when queried broadly. The available lookup functions support filtering by type and currency with a limit parameter, but lack random sampling or field restriction beyond specified return fields. Individual record lookups by identifier work, and bulk filtered queries can retrieve limited result sets to prevent system overload. I need to use the lookup_account function with appropriate filters and limits to retrieve account information successfully.
